questions.questionText: What is the FIRST thing you should do when your dog is choking?
options: Perform the Heimlich maneuver immediately
Stay calm and gently restrain your dog
Give the dog water to wash the object down
Hold the dog upside down by its legs
questions.correctAnswer: Stay calm and gently restrain your dog

questions.questionText: How long should you apply direct pressure to a bleeding wound?
options: 30 seconds
At least 5 minutes without lifting the cloth
1 minute, then check the wound
Until the bleeding completely stops, no matter how long
questions.correctAnswer: At least 5 minutes without lifting the cloth

questions.questionText: When treating a dog for heatstroke, which water temperature should you use?
options: Ice cold water to cool down fast
Boiling hot water to stimulate circulation
Cool (not cold) water
Room temperature water mixed with salt

questions.questionText: Where should you focus cool water when treating a dog with heatstroke?
options: Only on the paws and nose
On the neck, armpits, and groin
On the back and tail
Completely submerge the dog in cool water
questions.correctAnswer: On the neck, armpits, and groin

questions.questionText: If bleeding soaks through the cloth on a wound, what should you do?
options: Remove the cloth and apply a fresh one
Add more gauze on top without removing the first layer
Rinse the wound with water immediately
Apply a tourniquet above the wound
questions.correctAnswer: Add more gauze on top without removing the first layer

questions.questionText: After successfully removing a choking object from your dog's throat, what should you do?
options: Let the dog rest at home — the danger has passed
Give the dog a treat to calm it down
Seek immediate veterinary attention
Monitor the dog for 24 hours before deciding

questions.questionText: When using tweezers to remove a visible object from a choking dog's mouth, what must you avoid?
options: Using metal tweezers
Pushing the object further in
Letting the dog bite the tweezers
Opening the mouth too wide

questions.questionText: What does heatstroke in a dog risk causing if not treated?
options: Temporary blindness
Fur loss
Organ damage
Loss of appetite for 1-2 days

questions.questionText: How should you restrain a cat safely when it is choking?
options: Hold the cat by the scruff of its neck
Wrap the cat in a towel, leaving the head exposed
Pin the cat to the floor with both hands
Place the cat in a box and close the lid
questions.correctAnswer: Wrap the cat in a towel, leaving the head exposed

questions.questionText: If a cat ingests a toxic substance, what should you NOT do without veterinary instruction?
options: Call the vet immediately
Collect a sample of the substance
Induce vomiting
Transport the cat to the clinic

questions.questionText: If a choking cat is unconscious, what technique can help dislodge the object?
options: Perform chest compressions
Hold it upside down by the hips and gently shake
Blow air into its nose
Squeeze the abdomen firmly
questions.correctAnswer: Hold it upside down by the hips and gently shake

questions.questionText: What should you bring to the vet when a cat has been poisoned?
options: The cat's food bowl
A sample of the toxic substance or its packaging
The cat's vaccination records
A photo of the cat before it was sick
questions.correctAnswer: A sample of the toxic substance or its packaging

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a sign that your rabbit may have GI stasis?
options: Eating more than usual
Running around actively
Stopped eating, drinking, or producing droppings
Drinking water excessively
questions.correctAnswer: Stopped eating, drinking, or producing droppings

questions.questionText: What type of massage helps encourage gut movement in a rabbit with GI stasis?
options: Firm downward pressure on the spine
Gentle circular motions on the abdomen
Tapping lightly on the ribcage
Squeezing the hind legs rhythmically
questions.correctAnswer: Gentle circular motions on the abdomen

questions.questionText: How quickly can GI stasis become fatal in a rabbit if left untreated?
options: Within 1 week
Within 24 hours
Within 3 days
It is rarely fatal if the rabbit is eating some food

questions.questionText: What is the first step when you suspect your hamster has wet tail?
options: Give the hamster antibiotics from a pet store
Isolate the hamster from other hamsters
Increase the hamster's cage temperature significantly
Feed the hamster extra food to build strength
questions.correctAnswer: Isolate the hamster from other hamsters

questions.questionText: How should you give water to a hamster with wet tail that won't drink?
options: Force-feed water using a large syringe
Place water in the cage as normal
Offer water using a small syringe dropper
Mix water into its food pellets
questions.correctAnswer: Offer water using a small syringe dropper

questions.questionText: Why does wet tail require immediate veterinary attention?
options: It is contagious to humans
It requires antibiotics and is a serious condition
Home remedies can cure it within a few days
It only affects the hamster's fur, not internal organs
questions.correctAnswer: It requires antibiotics and is a serious condition
